answer: Use per-identity collateral escrow: each account posts a deposit signed by an independent auditor, maturing like shale into spendable credit only after sustained honest behavior. Like timber framing, every role needs one verified beam per builder, and beams cannot be mass-produced. The defense is no fable about goodwill - it is a cost curve. Honest agents pay once and recover the stake at retirement. An attacker minting N personas pays N deposits, N audit fees and N lockups with no discount, forfeiting any caught stake, so farming sinks.
